title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
tagline: Lamb for everyone. Even the vegetarian.
about: A thirty-year-old Greek-American woman in Chicago falls for a man who isn't Greek, and her huge, loud family has plenty to say about it.
cue: Serve the snacks when Toula is pouring coffee at the family restaurant and Ian walks in.

Mix the feta, ricotta, egg, mint and a good grind of pepper.Lay out 1 filo sheet, brush with butter, lay a second on top and brush again. Cut lengthways into 3 strips. Repeat with the rest.Put a heaped teaspoon of filling at the end of each strip and fold over and over into a triangle. Toss the potatoes in a roasting tin with the potato oil, lemon juice, garlic and oregano and pour in the stock.Roast the potatoes, turning twice, until golden and the liquid has gone.Meanwhile heat a barbecue to high and cook the lamb for 10 to 12 minutes a side until charred outside and pink inside.Rest the lamb under foil for 15 minutes.Carve thickly and serve with the lemon potatoes and the pan juices.SweetsHarriet's honey walnut ring cakeThe bundt cake with a pot plantHow to make it200g butter, softened200g caster sugar, for the cake4 eggs2 oranges, 1 zested and both juiced250g self-raising flour1 tsp ground cinnamon150g walnuts, chopped125g Greek yoghurt200g caster sugar, for the syrup200ml water, for the syrup3 tbsp honey1 cinnamon stickHeat the oven to 170°C and butter and flour a 24cm Bundt tin.Beat the butter and cake sugar until pale and fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time with the orange zest.Fold in the flour, cinnamon, walnuts and yoghurt and spoon into the tin.Bake until a skewer comes out clean.Meanwhile simmer the syrup sugar, water, honey, orange juice and cinnamon stick for 5 minutes, then cool.Cool the cake in the tin for 10 minutes, turn out onto a plate and spoon the cool syrup slowly over the hot cake.Leave to soak before slicing.DrinksToula's iced coffee frappeToula pouring coffee, waiting for lifeHow to make it4 tsp instant coffee4 tsp caster sugar120ml cold water4 cups ice400ml cold milkShake the coffee, sugar and cold water hard in a sealed jar until it turns into a thick, pale foam.Fill 4 tall glasses with the ice.Spoon the coffee foam over the ice.Top slowly with the cold milk and serve with a straw.Ouzo over ice with waterIan's first round.
